svg.title: How homeprod is put together
svg.desc: Internet traffic on ports 80 and 443 reaches Traefik on docker-pi, a Raspberry Pi 5, which serves mywebsite and homepage. Admin access comes over the tailnet to a two-node Proxmox cluster running media, photo, document and Git services. Komodo Periphery on docker-pi reports to Komodo Core on the cluster, and the cluster backs up to a separate Proxmox Backup Server.
